notes:
BLOCKING, reproduced and unresolved: constructorArgs[1] is address(1), not the launched BurnTaxToken. BurnTaxHook stores it immutably; native ETH/BTAX swaps then return zero hook deltas, emit no Burned event and deliver no BTAX to DEAD in all four swap modes. Do not deploy this manifest. A verified launch-token address or its actual deterministic deployment inputs is required; neither is supplied. Replace this argument only with that verified address, then repeat review and hook salt mining against the resolved arguments and actual deployer. The verifier rejects $token; fixture addresses, invented addresses and notes cannot resolve this binding. Constructor order is (IPoolManager manager_, address token_); only $poolManager is resolved by the deployer. Both arguments become immutable. BurnTaxToken has no constructor arguments.

Intended pool: native ETH as currency0 and the launched BTAX token as currency1, using BurnTaxHook, a 3000 (0.3%) LP fee and tick spacing 60. Initial sqrtPriceX96 is 2^96, matching the repository fixtures: a 1:1 BTAX/ETH ratio in base units, also 1 BTAX per ETH with 18 decimals. This is an explicit fixture-based initial-price assumption, not an observed market price. The hook accepts all three listed fee tiers and never overrides the pool's LP fee.

For every successful swap containing its configured token, the hook sends floor(gross BTAX leg / 100) to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD. Buys receive BTAX and sells pay BTAX regardless of currency ordering. Exact-input buys deduct floor(AMM token output / 100); exact-input sells reserve floor(specified token input / 100). Exact-output buys request net token output plus floor(net / 99), burning the latter; exact-output sells add floor(AMM token input / 99) to the trader's token payment. Positive return deltas charge the trader and balance PoolManager.take, immediately or through settleBurn within the same unlock. Burned(bytes32 indexed poolId, bool indexed isBuy, uint256 amount) reports the actual transfer, including zero after rounding. Unrelated pools return zero deltas and emit no burn event.

Limits: exact-input sells and exact-output buys revert on partial fills; the other two modes tax executed volume. Immediate delivery requires sufficient PoolManager BTAX and no open BTAX sync. Otherwise the router must fund the manager, close the sync and call settleBurn within the same unlock; omission reverts the swap and event. settleBurn is permissionless and pays only DEAD. No native ETH fee, ERC-6909 claims or later redemption exists. Very small trades can round to zero tax. Transfers, liquidity operations and pools using another hook are untaxed. Transfers to DEAD do not reduce totalSupply. The token has fixed supply and no further mint path. Neither contract has an owner, admin, upgrade or withdrawal path; the 1% cannot change. Standard ERC-20 behavior and a Cancun-compatible chain are required.

All five declared permissions match getHookPermissions; all other permissions are false. Every enabled callback authenticates PoolManager and verifies the hook address in the pool key. Mine the deployed hook address for low-14-bit flags 0x20cc (8396) using the final constructor arguments, and initialize the pool atomically with deployment. Existing tests use real PoolManagers and cover all four swap modes, both token orderings, events, DEAD balances, unrelated pools, supported LP fees, fresh managers, fuzzing and settlement invariants. README.md documents the rule and integration limits. This technical manifest does not set launch-policy supply or allocations or establish deployment approval.
